Tells whether this platform has a mouse that [RawInput](RawInput) can ask for without the acceleration of the system. That is the case on Windows, Linux (X11 and Wayland) and macOS with a mouse attached, and not where there is no window system or no mouse. Where it is 0, RawInput is accepted and changes nothing.
@returns 1 if raw mouse input is available, otherwise 0.
@gap This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
